product.description: Blackbird™ PRO by Monoprice™USB 2.0 4-Port Extender Over Cat5e/Cat6Connect and control up to four USB devices at distances up to 164 feetThis Blackbird™ PRO USB 2.0 4‑Port Extender allows you to extend a USB 2.0 connection to distances up to 164 feet (50 meters) over a single Cat5e or Cat6 Ethernet cable. It features a 4‑port USB hub on the receiver. The transmitter is powered by the USB connection to your computer, while the receiver is powered by a 12 VDC, 2A power adapter. The receiver can provide 5 VDC, 1A of power to each of two connected devices and 5 VDC, 500mA of power to each of two other connected devices.Extend a USB 2.0 connection to distances up to 164 feet (50 meters) over a single Cat5e/Cat6 Ethernet cableSupports data rates up to 480Mbps4‑port USB hub on the receiverProvides 5 VDC, 1A of power to each of two connected devices and 5 VDC, 500mA of power to each of two other connected devicesUniversal compatibility ‑ extends ANY USB 2.0 connectionTrue plug and play device, no installation or additional drivers required EXTEND YOUR PERIPHERYExtend any USB 2.0 connection for up to four USB devices to distances up to 164 feet (50 meters) over a single Cat5e or Cat6 Ethernet cable, significantly further than the normal 16‑foot maximum USB extension. BRISK BANDWIDTHDespite the additional distance, this extender supports the full USB 2.0 standard data transfer rate of up to 480Mbps. PROJECT YOUR POWERThe receiver uses a dedicated AC power adapter, which allows it to provide up to 1A of charging power to two of the ports and up to 500mA of power to the other two ports. FUN FOR FOURThe integrated 4‑port hub on the receiver allows you to connect and control up to four USB peripherals, while using only a single USB port on your source device. PLUG AND PLAYDon't worry about drivers of configuration with this extender.
